header.superHtml:
Our musical toothbrushes make mighty mouths by transforming brush time into a dance party. Get ready for toothbrush songs! Research shows a 73% increase in brushing time using musical toothbrushes. Our music toothbrush has four songs, which play for two minutes each (the dentist recommended time for brushing), and automatically shut off when the song is done. Kids can also watch the Tooth Keri magically come to life using the included augmented reality (AR) sticker for tips on how to make their teeth sprite brite.

  • comes in characters: Dr. HaveOneSuperSmile, Tooth Keri, Melo-D, Bristles, Moler, Cavitar
  • premium bristles
  • easy grip
  • plays music for two minutes
  • comes with 4 songs
  • augmented reality sticker: 'Tooth Keri' - your child's interactive guide to proper brushing and flossing, brought to life through engaging AR technology
  • recommended for ages: 2-12 years

reviews.name: Tonja
reviews.title: Not just for kids!
reviews.body: Hello! I'm kind of embarrassed to say this, but I'm 57 years old and I bought this for myself! I learned how important it is to take care of your teeth not just for dental health, but it also helps with heart health! And many other things. I have anxiety and depression and using this just makes my morning happy. It helps me forget about the pressure and stress of the day! I'm hoping pretty soon I can learn the songs and sing along although it will be difficult with a toothbrush in my mouth lol. And I can honestly say that I really thought I was brushing my teeth long enough but this showed me that I wasn't. I'm truly glad I bought it even though my husband makes fun of me (light heartedly) for dancing along while I brush my teeth. He just doesn't know what he's missing!! I would recommend this product to anyone and everyone! Public Reply (Supermouth)
